name: Hex
tagline: AI analytics platform for data exploration
description: Hex is described as an AI analytics platform for trusted data exploration, with agentic notebooks, conversational self-serve analytics and interactive data apps.
features: Enterprise: OIDC SSO, audit logs and bring-your-own-key
useCases: Exploring and analysing data with AI help
strengths: Professional is free for students and educators (per the FAQ)
limitations: Prices are per Editor; the billing interval behind them was not stated
Community is limited to small compute and 5 published apps

free.details: Community is free: a Hex agent trial, small compute, up to 5 published apps, 7-day version history, up to 3 shared collections and 3 shared components.

pricing.trial: Team: 14 days free (no card, per the FAQ); an extended 30-day trial of Hex Team is linked.

plans.name: Professional
plans.billing: Per Editor per month; monthly versus annual billing was not stated

plans.name: Team
plans.billing: Per Editor per month; monthly versus annual billing was not stated

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD. Pay-as-you-go compute is available on Team and Enterprise (for example Large at $0.32 per hour).

verification.notes: Product active (Hex 4.0 announced). Community free; Professional $36 and Team $75 per editor/month (Team: 14 days free); Enterprise custom. The page does not say whether prices are monthly or annual billing, so it stays partial.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: An AI analytics platform for notebooks, self-serve questions and data apps

capabilities.title: Build analyses with an agent
capabilities.text: The Notebook Agent builds analyses and charts in agentic notebooks.

capabilities.title: Ask questions in plain language
capabilities.text: Threads is conversational analytics for questions about your data.

capabilities.title: Explore data without code
capabilities.text: Explore gives business users self-serve data exploration.

capabilities.title: Share results as apps
capabilities.text: Publish generative dashboards and interactive data apps, with an App Agent for questions inside them.

featureCards.name: Context Studio and Context Engine
featureCards.text: Manage the business definitions and models that ground AI answers, and see where context is missing.

featureCards.name: Evals
featureCards.text: Test changes before production and measure their effect on agent accuracy, comparing price and quality across models.

featureCards.name: Slack and MCP
featureCards.text: Query Hex from Slack or from assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex.

featureCards.name: Governance and observability
featureCards.text: Enterprise permissions and thread-level visibility into token spend.

featureCards.name: Model choice
featureCards.text: Supports several models, including open-source ones.

featureCards.name: Data stack integrations
featureCards.text: Warehouses and databases, dbt metadata, GitHub and GitLab export, and Airflow, Dagster and Prefect.

audienceDetail.text: Answers to their own questions without SQL or Python.
Query governed data from an assistant while keeping one trusted data layer.

scenarios.title: Move from static dashboards to self-serve
scenarios.text: Replace a traditional BI report with conversational analytics.

scenarios.title: Build a shared context layer
scenarios.text: Give agents trusted definitions to reason from.

scenarios.title: Answer a question from Slack
scenarios.text: Keep the data governed while people ask in chat.

scenarios.title: Embed a dashboard
scenarios.text: Put interactive analysis where your teams already work.

gettingStarted.text: Use Get started for free at app.hex.tech, or request a demo.

gettingStarted.step: Optional: set up the MCP server
gettingStarted.text: Use Hex from your AI assistant; the page links a setup guide.
